thread:
orchidpay-sec: Hi team — we just got a bespoke security questionnaire from OrchidPay. They want: 1) exported keystore/KMS access logs, 2) sample audit logs for token access, and 3) retention proof for 7 years. due in 48h. can you advise whether we can produce the exports and a log sample?

maya: ack — can you paste the exact CSV/format they asked for? is this the CAIQ SIG form or a custom one?

orchidpay-sec: It's a bespoke PDF with a table asking for 'keystore export sample (format & sha256)', 'kms key rotation events', and a 'log retention certificate'. they want gzip'd logs and an example of the mapping to our schema.

ethan: 48h is tight. quick notes: our default audit logs retention is 90 days in hosted, longer for Private. '7 years' will need an attestation + export. we can produce a sample export for the last 30 days and a signed statement for retention policy.

zoe: for the export — SRE can run the keystore audit export. two gotchas: 1) exports are throttled, may return intermittent 401s if the service account token rotates; 2) the export pipeline zips & GPG-signs, filename pattern: logs/keystore-audit-<start>-<end>.gz.sig

raj: @zoe can you run the export and paste the command you'll use? i'll watch for 401s and escalate infra if needed.

zoe: sure. command we'll run on prod bastion:
```
# run export for last 30d
./export_keystore_audit.sh --from=2025-12-01 --to=2025-12-31 --out=/tmp/orchidpay-sample.gz
# then sign
gpg --output /tmp/orchidpay-sample.gz.sig --detach-sign /tmp/orchidpay-sample.gz
```

kevin: note: there was a known token rotation bug last week that could cause short 401 spikes for service-account-based exports. ops-bot reported and patched, but some nodes might still have stale creds. i'll run a quick health check against exporter nodes.

ops-bot: exporter-node-3: stale-iam-token detected (resetting)...

ethan: if we hit 401s, quick repro steps: run the curl against the exporter's internal API:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://exporter.internal.redwood/v1/keystore/audit?from=2025-12-01&to=2025-12-31 -o /tmp/raw.json
```

orchidpay-sec: if you can provide the gz + .sig and a short mapping doc (CSV column -> field description) that should satisfy them. can we also include a short note about KMS rotation events (last rotation timestamp + KMS audit link)?

maya: yes — deliverables we'll prepare: 1) gz export sample (30d), 2) detached signature (.sig), 3) CSV schema mapping, 4) note on retention policy and private deployment options for 7-year retention.

zoe: export started, ETA ~10m. hitting one 401 retry but exporter retried and completed. uploading to secure share now.

kevin: health check done — nodes reset. leaving a postmortem note in eng-ops.

ethan: uploaded sample to /secure/orchidpay/keystore-audit-sample-2025-12-01_12-00.gz and attached mapping doc. sending draft attestation for legal review.

orchidpay-sec: thanks — can we get a 3-day extension on the questionnaire due date just in case legal needs to edit wording?

maya: i'll request an extension from their security contact now. ping back when legal finishes the attestation. :thumbsup:

orchidpay-sec: extension requested, they said tentatively ok for +3 days. will confirm in thread.

maya: closing loop — everything sent except final legal attestation. will update when confirmed.

orchidpay-sec: confirmed, they accepted +3 days. thanks all :party-popper:
